name: Yarmouth Chamber Music Festival
tagline: Chamber music, close up, on Nova Scotia's southern shore.
description: An autumn festival of chamber music in kitchens, chapels and concert halls across Yarmouth, Nova Scotia.
acknowledgement: The festival takes place in Mi'kma'ki, the ancestral and unceded territory of the Mi'kmaq People.
about: Placeholder. The Yarmouth Chamber Music Festival brings musicians of international standing to Yarmouth each autumn for a week and a half of concerts in the places where people actually gather: kitchens, chapels, halls and churches.
Placeholder. The music is played close enough to see the bows move. Programs pair the great works of the repertoire with new music, and the artists stay on afterward to talk.

support.headline: Every concert is made possible by people who believe there should be music like this in Yarmouth.
text: Placeholder. Ticket sales cover only part of what it costs to bring artists to Yarmouth. Gifts of any size go directly to artist fees, travel and the venues that host us.
We are also grateful to the volunteers who usher, drive, cook and billet. If you would like to help, we would love to hear from you.
